name: Street Custom 'Paper Tiger' Decoy Wallet
description: A realistic-looking wallet or purse loaded with expired credit chits, fake identity cards, and a concealed GPS tracker that activates when the wallet is opened. The Paper Tiger is designed to be surrendered during a mugging or pickpocket event, satisfying the attacker's demand while providing nothing of value and tracking the thief's subsequent movements. Some variants include a dye pack that stains the thief's hands, a chemical irritant capsule, or a micro-flashbang that detonates 30 seconds after opening. The device has become common enough that experienced street criminals in GLMZ now check wallets for trackers before fleeing.

specifications.info: fake IDs; GPS tracker; 72-hour battery; chemical irritant; micro-flashbang

story_hooks: A Paper Tiger tracker led its owner to the location of a organized fencing operation — the wallet was stolen as bait to map the criminal network's physical infrastructure.
A Paper Tiger variant has been weaponized with a shaped explosive instead of a dye pack — several muggers have been killed by wallets that detonate when opened.

physical_description.visual_profile: A conventionally styled bifold or clutch wallet designed for perfect visual mimicry of legitimate currency carriers. Its form factor is deliberately unremarkable—the kind of accessory that disappears into daily wear. The exterior appears aged and slightly worn, with creasing patterns that suggest authentic use. No visible indicators of its decoy nature.
physical_description.weight_description: 150 grams — light enough for pocket carry, weighted realistically with card stock and expired chits to feel authentic during a cursory search
physical_description.primary_material: Synthetic leather or genuine leather with RFID-blocking weave; internal chassis is recycled polymer composite housing the tracker module
physical_description.finish: Matte or satin leather-look surface with natural wear patterns deliberately scuffed into corners and edges. Interior fabric is worn cotton blend with authentic patina staining.
physical_description.color_scheme: Muted earth tones — charcoal, weathered tan, or midnight black. Stitching in contrasting thread (burnt orange, sage green, silver-grey) mimics legitimate brands. No chrome or neon accents that might signal modification.
physical_description.interface_elements: Minimal by design. A hairline seam along one edge conceals the pressure-sensitive GPS activation switch. Faint LED indicator (red/green, <3mm diameter) hidden behind interior card slot, barely visible in dim light. Optional secondary switch for manual disarm, disguised as reinforcing rivet.
distinctive_features: Perfectly aged exterior — no signs of synthetic newness
Interior conceals modular tracker pod mounted in central spine cavity
Fake credit chits mimic QUANTA currency cards with expired dates (2215-2219)
Counterfeit identity cards from multiple jurisdictions (GLMZ administrative districts, some out-of-zone fakes for plausibility)
If equipped: dye pack rupture points visible only under infrared as hairline stress-concentration points
If equipped: micro-flashbang canister (12mm × 8mm) nestled in reinforced card slot, indistinguishable from thick security card
Encrypted transmission antenna woven into synthetic leather backing — invisible to visual inspection
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: Subtle 'STREET CUSTOM' embossing on exterior rear, barely raised (0.5mm), designed to blend with legitimate brand logos. No UPC or regulatory stamps that might draw scrutiny. Some units carry intentional 'wear marks' where a fake corporate logo once was.
physical_description.condition_typical: Worn and scuffed like genuine carry. Slight discoloration from simulated sun exposure. Faint creasing in leather consistent with months of pocket carry. Interior shows handling stains and fading consistent with real-world use. Ready to surrender immediately.
